kicker: A RECEIPT FOR THE WHOLE SELF
title:
Three datasets.
One very human shape.
body: Your household choices, card swipes and listening rituals are different kinds of evidence. Together, they make a softer picture of a year.

title:
The little things
do the talking.
body: Most of a spending story is made from ordinary categories — the repeatable, easy-to-miss rituals that keep a day moving.

title:
Some choices
arrive by card.
body: The card dataset adds another lens: a wider, more varied set of purchases. We keep only category, date and amount — never identity.

title:
And every day
has a rhythm.
body: The listening history is not spending at all. It is context: the songs, skips and platforms that give the numbers a little weather.
